question: In a certain code language, 'DUKE' is coded as 'ZQGA'. What is the code for 'EXIT' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'DUKE' is coded as 'ZQGA'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12b8787e1437a8eee57508002ae549fdfba856b3099d330f164bedafd8f8f00d.png] 

Similarly,

'EXIT' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2559c1cbf95cc708e5b9d9e06708c7975caca7780f0cdc6605f999568baedb4b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ATEP".**
